text.p: Indonesian cement producer Semen Gresik was up 10 percent by midsession on Thursday on foreign buying as positive sentiment boosted the overall Jakarta stock market, brokers said.
Semen Gresik was up 700 rupiah to 7,700 rupiah on a turnover of 723,500 shares by 0500 GMT.

"I think it is just an effect from the rally on the Jakarta market today. From its fundamentals, I recommend a "hold" until its projected production figures for 1997 are available. But it's good to have it now," an analyst from a Hongkong securities firm said.
Another foreign analyst said Semen Gresik could be benefiting from recent reports that Indonesia did not face any immediate problem of cement oversupply.
"Nothing much has happen on its fundamentals. Personally I even prefer Semen Cibinong to Semen Gresik. But in terms of price movement, Semen Gresik is fairly stable," she said.
Brokers said the stock appeared to have reached its upper level, with possible profit-taking limiting movement.
